comments: The list of Ral gri's writings by bSam gtan bzang po (ID:4005) mentions one commentary on the Apohasiddhi, which may refer to either the work by Dharmottara or by Śaṅkaranandana ([FZ6N88AU]: 409), which Ral gri's list of his writings (ID:7112) mentions commentaries on both treatises (see also (ID:7133)).
name: gzhan sel ti ka (1)
